fusions.name: Snaring Strand
fusions.desc: A lashing strand that deals 9 damage. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Silk Cocoon
fusions.desc: Spews a wide cone of silk ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything caught in it. The blow ignores resistances. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Far Anchor
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Taut Silk
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
